title: Remember gate
summary: An episode is stored only when remember is explicit. Consent is given by use. There is no withdrawal command.
body: HORBM research note R3, 2026-11-18, kept episodes off disk until remember. Owner decision, Mate, 2026-11-18 21:57: using the system is consent. An admin may archive one row with forget. The archive keeps the text and search does not read it.

sources.title: Galion Labs, HORBM R3 memory, persona, empathy, 2026-11-18
